artifacts.name: RuntimeEnvironmentIdentity
artifacts.description: Typed, privacy-preserving identity for the resolved runner, cwd, tools, config, dependencies, and effective command environment.

artifacts.name: effective_environment_digest
artifacts.description: Digest only; raw environment values, credentials, and secrets are never persisted.

artifacts.name: RuntimeEvidenceCompleteness
artifacts.description: Explicit completeness state and fail-closed diagnostics.

artifacts.name: RuntimeContextEvidence
artifacts.description: Node, fixture, collection, or session context with consuming-node attribution.

artifacts.name: lifecycle_equivalent
artifacts.description: True only when grouping provably preserves this fixture lifecycle.

artifacts.name: RuntimeGroupEvidence
artifacts.description: One physical compatible-group execution before selector evidence is projected to original command identities.

artifacts.name: RuntimeCommandEvidence
artifacts.description: One exact command identity, selected nodes, contexts, result, and completeness.

artifacts.name: RuntimeEvidenceBundle
artifacts.description: Invocation-scoped command evidence bound to current source/test/config bytes.

artifacts.name: RuntimeEvidenceRun
artifacts.description: Ordinary results for executed compatible groups plus their evidence bundle.

artifacts.name: collect_runtime_evidence
artifacts.description: Executes each proven-compatible group once and returns exact-command maps without evaluating coverage findings.

artifacts.name: combine_runtime_contexts
artifacts.description: Combines same-ID controller/worker contexts without losing line, call, consumer, or lifecycle evidence.

artifacts.name: runtime_evidence_is_current
artifacts.description: Recomputes content and resolved-environment identity without executing tests and rejects stale in-memory evidence.

artifacts.name: RuntimeEvidencePlugin
artifacts.description: Pytest plugin recording node, fixture, collection, call, and worker contexts.

artifacts.name: pytest_fixture_setup
artifacts.description: Hookwrapper switches to a fixture context around real setup without replacing the fixture result.

artifacts.name: pytest_runtest_teardown
artifacts.description: Hookwrapper attributes execution during runtest and fixture teardown, while unproven wider-scope lifecycles remain fallback-only.

artifacts.name: pytest_fixture_post_finalizer
artifacts.description: Records completed fixture finalization and marks any teardown without a proven equivalent lifecycle incomplete.

artifacts.name: pytest_configure_node
artifacts.description: Keeps private instrumentation only until every configured xdist worker has inherited it, then clears the controller environment.

artifacts.name: execute_with_contexts
artifacts.description: Runs one contextual compatible group and combines controller/worker files into typed group evidence for exact-command projection.
